report: Experts Say the 'New Normal' in 2025 Will Be Far More Tech-Driven, Presenting More Big Challenges
publisher: Pew Research Center and Elon University's Imagining the Internet Center

entries.label: Life in 2025 after the pandemic
entries.quote: Consider the changes that are being set in motion by the COVID-19 outbreak and the way societies are responding. Do you predict these changes will lead to life in 2025 that is... Mostly BETTER for most people than life was at the time the pandemic began / Mostly WORSE [...] / Not much different from the way things would have turned out if there had been no pandemic
entries.subject: life after the COVID-19 pandemic
entries.note: 915 responded to at least one question in the report.
entries.answer_mapping: agree = mostly better for most people; disagree = mostly worse for most people

notes: One closed question from a non-random opt-in canvassing, followed by open-ended elaboration (not captured). Pew calls the results nonscientific and not projectable.
